title: Black, Gray and White
statement: The task is to pick k in [1, 2n] for a tree with n up to 3·10^5 so that pairing each vertex i with k−i maximizes black endpoints, then gray path vertices. A parity argument settles even n with k = n+1; for odd n only k ∈ {n, n+1, n+2} leave one vertex unpaired, and a DFS rooted there checks whether any pair spans two different child subtrees.
